verdict.rationale: Vue's own docs explicitly market it as 'a rich, incrementally adoptable ecosystem that scales between a library and a full-featured framework,' and community evidence corroborates both the drop-in-script use case (download vue.min.js, no build tools needed) and full SPA/app usage with official router/state libraries. This matches the story precisely across both ends of the scale. Missing for 10: independent case study specifically documenting a gradual migration project (only vendor claim + anecdotal community support, no dedicated hands-on incremental-adoption walkthrough).
